transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... my eating’s been off for a while. Months, maybe. Some days I barely have toast and coffee, and then other days I’m buying sweets at the bakery even though I don’t really want them. It just feels... not like me.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I’m not sure about the weight, really. I haven’t been checking. My appetite’s just been... strange for months—some days barely toast and coffee, other days buying sweets I don’t even want.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, feeling like you can't stop?

Not exactly like I can’t stop. It’s more… my eating’s just been off for months. Some days I barely pick at toast and coffee, and other days I end up buying sweets at the bakery even though I don’t really enjoy them.
Do you feel like you're in control when you're eating those sweets?

I don’t know if I’d call it out of control. It’s more like… my eating’s been all turned around for months. Some days it’s just toast and coffee, and then sometimes I’m in the bakery buying sweets I don’t even really want.
Do you feel guilty after eating those sweets?
A little, I guess. Mostly I just feel… off about it. Like I didn’t really want them, but I’m standing there buying them anyway. My eating’s just been turned around like that for months.
Do you ever do anything to try to counteract the sweets you eat, like exercising or vomiting?
No… not really. I don’t make myself sick or anything like that. I’m not much for exercising either.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Not really afraid, no. It’s more that my eating’s been strange for months… some days hardly anything, and other days I’m buying sweets I don’t even enjoy.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that is larger than what most people would eat in a short period of time?

Sometimes, maybe. It’s not like a huge meal exactly… more like I’ll barely eat some days, just toast and coffee, and then other days I’m standing there buying sweets in the bakery aisle. I don’t even really enjoy them.
Do you think about your weight or body shape when you're deciding what to eat?
I don’t think so… not in any clear way. I don’t really sit there thinking about my shape when I eat. It’s more just… whatever I can manage, I guess.
Are you worried about gaining weight when you eat those sweets?

No… I don’t think it’s about gaining weight. It’s just my eating’s been all turned around for months. Some days it’s barely toast and coffee, and then other days I’m buying sweets I don’t even really want.
Are you ever concerned that the sweets you buy might cause you to gain weight?

Not really, no. I came in more because my eating’s been… off for months. Some days I just pick at toast and coffee, and other days I end up buying sweets in the bakery aisle, even though I don’t really enjoy them.
Are you afraid of gaining weight from eating sweets?
No… I wouldn’t say I’m afraid of that. It doesn’t really come into my mind that way.
Do you think you would be upset if you gained a significant amount of weight?
I don’t know… I guess anyone might be upset by that. But it’s not something I really think about much.
Do you think your eating habits would change if you didn't have to worry about your weight at all?
No… I don’t think it’s really about weight. My eating’s just been all turned around for months. Some days it’s just toast and coffee, and other days I end up buying sweets I don’t even really want.
Do you feel distressed about your eating habits?

Yes… I mean, it bothers me. It’s not really about weight, it’s just… for months it’s been all over the place. Some days I barely pick at toast and coffee, and other days I’m standing there buying sweets I don’t even really enjoy.
Has your unusual eating pattern been interfering with your daily activities or relationships?

A little, yeah. I still do what I have to for my aunt, the basic things. But I’ve missed some church planning calls, and I keep putting off fair projects. Neighbors have had to cover things I used to just handle myself… so it’s made things harder than they used to be.
Have you noticed any significant change in the way your clothes fit over the past few months?
I haven’t really been checking how my clothes fit. I just know my eating’s been off for months… some days it’s just toast and coffee, and other days I’m buying sweets I don’t even want.
Have you lost any weight unintentionally over the past few months?

I’m not really sure about the weight. I haven’t been keeping track. I just know my eating’s been turned around for months… some days it’s barely toast and coffee, and then other days I’m buying sweets I don’t even want.
Have you lost a noticeable amount of weight over the past few months?

I don’t know about a noticeable amount. I haven’t really checked. I just know my eating’s been all over the place for months—some days it’s just toast and coffee, then other days I’m buying sweets I don’t even want.
Have you noticed that your clothes are looser on you than they used to be?
I haven’t really noticed the clothes part. It’s more that my eating’s been… off for months. Some days I barely pick at toast and coffee, then other times I’m buying sweets I don’t even enjoy.
